scope: Preparation of lateral static candidates for wave25; source inspection only, no generated output acceptance or fidelity certification.
evidenceBasis: All seven local references were inspected visually at native source contents.

generationRefusalAudit.method: Read-only search of art/*.json provenance and directly associated production refusal records for these exact IDs and related identities.
generationRefusalAudit.limits: This is a record audit, not a prediction of image generation acceptance. Any new refusal must be preserved without retry or alternate identity.

profiles.name: Rinko-Like Entity
profiles.sourceHierarchy: The 2560×1440 concept sheet documents complete front, back, three-quarter and narrow side views; the 300×500 retail portrait corroborates head and upper body only.
morphologyObserved: Long black hair falls to the ground and extends behind the feet.
Purple robe panels with circular motifs; irregular dark textured surface with orange fissures and illuminated face area.
Two small dark feet are visible beneath the robe.
A lowered implement and hanging chain appear in front/three-quarter views.
profiles.composition: Exactly one manifestation of this catalog identity, complete silhouette in a lateral neutral pose. The source sheet contains multiple views of one identity, not a group to copy.
preserve: Keep the uncertain identity/age classification; no adult relabeling and no human face replacement.
Use the actual side view as the shape anchor and the other views only for materials and hidden volume.
Include the full hat, trailing hair, robe hem, feet and any depicted lowered implement/chain within the canvas.
Do not add school-age spawns, dolls, separate fire attacks, arena pieces or effects.
Existing gameplay role, source assertions and dedicated selection portrait stay unchanged.
profiles.decision: Eligible to attempt a first lateral candidate for this exact identity; complete silhouette is documented. Candidate remains a reconstruction rather than a measured 1:1 model.

profiles.name: Hinako’s Father
profiles.sourceHierarchy: The 2560×1440 sheet supplies complete front/back monstrous Father views and small human transformation studies; the 300×500 in-game image shows Father and Mother together and is corroboration only.
morphologyObserved: Large rounded swollen mass with a dark navy torn jacket.
Very short separated legs with two small feet.
Asymmetric appendages: one bent curled heavy appendage, one broad kitchen blade carried low.
The body is squat and much wider than the tiny human transformation studies.
profiles.composition: One monstrous Father only. Neither the mother at the right of the retail image nor the small human sketches are the requested subject.
preserve: Follow the recorded Ara-abare morphology and keep Father distinct from Mother.
Keep both feet, the full curved appendage and the whole kitchen blade inside the frame.
Do not use the double retail portrait as a group composition.
Mother shf_hinako_s_mother_165 has a previous refusal and must not be imported, reinterpreted or used as an alternate subject.
Use front/back agreement to reconstruct the lateral volume; a measured side orthographic view is not provided.
profiles.decision: Eligible to attempt a first lateral candidate of Father from the dedicated complete concept model. The side volume is reconstructed; no 1:1 claim.

profiles.name: Blood Baby

runtime.superReason: La source décrit un rejeton créé par sa mère ; aucune invocation de Blood Mama par Blood Baby n’est attestée. Attaque propre à relever.

profiles.sourceHierarchy: Prioritize Everson's textured production front/back model and neutral sculpt side view, corroborated by the retail bestiary portrait. Castillo's full concept confirms asymmetry but is secondary where its color or proportions differ.
morphologyObserved: Split elongated head forming a vertical mouth with visible tongue.
Broad torso and thin short lower limbs ending in small feet.
Strongly asymmetric arms: the subject's right arm is much larger, wears several dark straps and ends in a large clawed hand; the opposite arm is slender.
The Everson production model has compact proportions and a warm dark reddish surface; the Castillo concept has a paler head and larger exaggerated features.
profiles.composition: One whole canonical nonhuman Blood Baby individual in this asset. The current runtime role remains multi-body despite a single reviewed source model.
preserve: Keep the existing exact identity and source name; do not relabel as a human adult.
Do not include or substitute Mother, Blood Mama or Blood Guardian; the related mother profiles have historical refusals.
Keep the asymmetry and complete head, tongue, fingers, legs and feet in frame.
No invented summoning ability: superEnabled remains false.
A single static candidate does not establish an animation cycle or individual-only game mechanics.
profiles.decision: Eligible to attempt a first lateral candidate from a documented production model with profile evidence. Runtime multi-body classification and disabled super remain unchanged.

inspection.sourceUse: One native source object per generated candidate; source sheets are reference evidence rather than output layouts.
